Jordan (partnerships): FYI new partner (EdgeWave) asked about an on‑prem EAP for their SI customers. They want: 1) NDA + export controls check, 2) a short perf/thermal bench inside their datacenter, 3) a listing path for our marketplace tile, and 4) a joint launch email. Who can pick up each item?
Priya (eng-runtime): I can own the perf/bench side and provide a minimal runtime image. Need kernel+driver matrix from them.
Leo (infra): on-prem access is trickier. we'll need a partner-run agent or temporary VPN. Ops prefers agent + short-lived creds. I can scope the agent work. :warning:
Jordan (partnerships): good. partner prefers agent approach (no VPN). they also asked for demo hardware calibration logs + thermal graphs.
Natalie (legal): I'll review NDA + export control checklist. we should add an explicit clause about no customer PII ingestion and ownership of derived telemetry. ETA: 48h.
Sam (solutions): on the marketplace front, MarketplaceBot: what are tile requirements for an on-prem partner listing?
MarketplaceBot: Required for tile: icon (512x512), short description (<=200 chars), opaque pricing tiers, deployment script (terraform/ansible), security checklist URL. See docs/marketplace/onprem-guidelines.
Priya (eng-runtime): perf plan (sketch):
```
- target models: rdx-small, rdx-medium
- run types: calibration, throughput-sweep, long-duration soak (6h)
- collect: p50/p95 latency, CPU/GPU temp, power draw, kernel versions
- upload: s3://eap-edgewave/<run-id>/
```
Leo (infra): we'll need to stand up a temporary S3 endpoint or have them push to a pre-signed URL. OpsBot: create-presigned-bucket?
OpsBot: presigned-bucket created: s3://redwood-eap-edgewave-3187, expires 30 days.
Jordan (partnerships): timeline? partner wants two-week engagement late May. Can we land infra + NDA + marketplace checklist by May 10?
Priya (eng-runtime): bench image and runbook in ~5 business days if I get kernel matrix this week.
Natalie (legal): NDA and export control signoff by May 3 if partner provides required legal contact today. I'll add embargo wording for any joint press.
Sam (solutions): I can draft marketplace tile copy and a stub terraform deploy. Need a short descriptive sentence from partnerships.
Jordan (partnerships): draft copy: "Redwood + EdgeWave: on‑prem inference runtime for regulated deployments — validated by joint EAP" (I can iterate).
Priya (eng-runtime): request: please ask partner to whitelist a lightweight health port (tcp/8081) and a limited upload window for logs. Also we should run a smoke test day 0.
Leo (infra): confirmed. We'll ship an agent package and a bootstrap script. Example command I'll include in runbook: `curl -sSL https://install.redwood.ai/agent.sh | sudo bash -s -- --eap edgewave --out s3://redwood-eap-edgewave-3187`
Jordan (partnerships): partner asked about benchmarks being public. we'll commit to internal embargo until both bench + legal cleared; public blog/demo only after mutual signoff.
Natalie (legal): noted. adding mutual approval clause and embargo duration (30 days post-signoff) in the addendum.
MarketplaceBot: marketplace tile also needs a verified contact and support SLA level (standard/premium). Please pick one.
Sam (solutions): propose "premium" for now during EAP, can revert later.
Jordan (partnerships): action items: @Natalie NDA + export control by May 3; @Priya build image + runbook by May 10; @Leo agent + presigned bucket done (OpsBot done); @Sam draft marketplace tile + terraform by May 7; I'll coordinate partner contacts and press hold.
Priya (eng-runtime): I'll also add a minimal telemetry redaction pipeline (PII scrub) as part of the runbook.
Leo (infra): I've pinned agent task and will post the bootstrap URL internally when ready.
Natalie (legal): sending NDA to partner now (3187659991). please flag any redlines to legal@redwood.ai.
Jordan (partnerships): great — will update partner with tentative May 20 start window subject to NDA sign and infra readiness. closing thread for now, will reopen if timelines slip. :calendar:
Priya (eng-runtime): noted, will upload runbook link when available.
Sam (solutions): will post draft tile tomorrow for review.
OpsBot: reminder scheduled: follow-up on May 6 for status check.
